title: TRENT ALEXANDER-ARNOLD WANTED THE BALLON D'OR. NOW HE'S ON THE BENCH
description:
Ambition: ten out of ten. Starts: five out of sixteen.

In 2024, Trent Alexander-Arnold said he wanted to be the first full back to win the Ballon d'Or. This season he's started five of sixteen Real Madrid games. Under José Mourinho he sits behind Federico Valverde and Denzel Dumfries at right back, and he's started eighteen of a possible fifty LaLiga games since he joined.

The frustrating part is what he can do. He holds the Premier League record for assists by a defender, with sixty-four. Finding teammates is easy. Finding his name on the team sheet is harder. Jamie Carragher says he'd take him back to Liverpool, though that's talk only for now.

Is Mourinho right to pick Valverde and Dumfries ahead of him, or is Real Madrid wasting him? Where do you stand?
